name: photoscout
description: Photo spots, events and drives on one map

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @photoscout/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @photoscout/density && npm run build -w @photoscout-plugin/radio-garden && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @photoscout/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @photoscout/density && npm run build -w @photoscout-plugin/radio-garden && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w crawler
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @photoscout/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @photoscout/density && npx tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.test.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p services/crawler/tsconfig.test.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-sdk/tsconfig.test.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p web && npx tsc --noEmit -p plugins/radio-garden/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @photoscout/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @photoscout/density && npm test --workspaces
